facts.text: OceanOpticsTEC is the class for the TEC found in QE65000 and QE65Pro spectrometers
get_temperatures() sends command 0x6C and returns the PCB and heatsink temperatures, each decoded as a signed 16-bit value scaled by 0.003906
The TEC controller read is command 0x72
get_TEC_temperature() decodes the TEC temperature as a signed 16-bit integer divided by 10
The setpoint command 0x73 carries the temperature times 10 as a signed 16-bit integer
set_TEC_temperature() reads the temperature, disables the TEC controller, writes the setpoint, enables the fan, re-enables the TEC controller and waits 2 s
_set_tec_controller_state() switches the TEC controller off with state 0x00 and on with state 0x01 (command 0x71)
_set_fan_state() sends command 0x70 with state 0x01, and its docstring says the fan is always switched on because switching the fan off might be unsafe
_tec_controller_get_status() queries information address 17 and decodes the TEC enable state, the fan enable state and the setpoint as a signed 16-bit integer divided by 10
initialize_TEC() describes a setpoint of -17 as the standard value that results in a TEC temperature of -15 degrees Celsius; it is a chosen standard value, not a stated device range
